camel_example: aliyun cloudfw DescribeNatFirewallList --region cn-hangzhou --Status normal --RegionNo 'cn-hangzhou' --PageSize 10 --VpcId 'vpc-8vbwbo90rq0anm6t0000' --MemberUid 147783000000 --ProxyId 'proxy-nat97a000000' --ProxyName 'nat-firewall' --Lang zh --PageNo 1 --NatGatewayId 'ngw-bp123456g000000'
description_en: Retrieves the details of NAT firewalls
description_zh: 本接口用于获取NAT边界防火墙的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-nat-firewall-list --lang zh --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --proxy-id proxy-nat97a000000 --proxy-name nat-firewall --region-no cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-8vbwbo90rq0anm6t0000 --nat-gateway-id ngw-bp123456g000000 --status normal --member-uid 147783000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNatFirewallList

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en:
The number of NAT firewalls to display on each page in a paged query.

Default value: 10, which indicates that each page contains 10 results. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，设置每页包含NAT边界防火墙的数量。

默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果。最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The NAT firewall name. The name can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, Chinese characters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length and cannot start with an underscore
parameters.help_zh: NAT防火墙名称。支持大小写英文字母、中文、数字、下划线（_）、长度为[4,50]个字符,且不能以下划线开头
parameters.name: proxy_name

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC.

For more information about the regions supported by Cloud Firewall, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.help_zh:
VPC所在的地域ID。

关于云防火墙支持地域的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en:
The Cloud Firewall status. Valid values:

configuring: being created
deleting: being deleted
normal: normal
abnormal: abnormal
opening: being enabled
closing: being disabled
closed: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
云防火墙状态。取值：

configuring：创建中
deleting：删除中
normal：正常
abnormal：异常
opening：开启中
closing：关闭中
closed：已关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The UID of the member account of the current Alibaba Cloud account
